notes: Vanilla Assassination at 60 does not have Envenom or a real Mutilate rotation -- those are later-expansion redesigns. The Forever talent tree adds a talent-granted Mutilate (a four-rank chain 1310707/399956/1241582/1241584 at 30/40/50/60, registered per rank in sim/rogue/mutilate.go since the accuracy program's engine-melee lane; this file names the top rank and the level rewrite picks the learned one) and a Venom finisher (1310703, sim/rogue/venom.go) to this tree, named here as the intended combo-point builder ahead of Sinister Strike, and as an alternate finisher choice ahead of Eviscerate. Both are now implemented (rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28): a rogue who has spent the talent point casts them; a bare-build rogue who has not falls through to the vanilla Sinister Strike / Eviscerate loop underneath exactly as before, since the engine simply doesn't register the spell without the talent. Cold Blood is popped right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

expected_idle.reason: once Mutilate is talented, Venom (entry 2, spellId 1310703, condition currentComboPoints >= 5) sits ahead of this line in the priority list and claims the finisher slot every time (notes on entry 2: 'a talented rogue spends 5 combo points here instead of on Eviscerate below'), by design from an earlier fix round -- the ladder's level 50/60 rungs have the Mutilate talent, so this line never gets a combo point once Venom is live.

Slice and Dice shares Eviscerate's own five-combo-point floor and Eviscerate (or, once talented, Venom) claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant (this line's own notes, from an earlier fix round); once Venom is talented at level 50/60 it wins that race every time, so Slice and Dice is never reached -- a real DPS cost of the current priority order, not something this diagnosis pass redesigns.

Sinister Strike is the builder only for a rogue without Mutilate (its line is gated on Mutilate being unknown); from the rung where the talent is taken, Mutilate builds every combo point and Sinister Strike is idle by design.

engineering_notes.3: sim/rogue/venom.go: an untalented rogue has no Venom spell registered.
engineering_notes.4: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.
engineering_notes.6: sim/rogue/mutilate.go: an untalented rogue has no Mutilate spell registered.

priorityList.notes: Rupture whenever it is not on the target and you have four or more combo points: the bleed ticks for the whole fight and was the largest single gain the search found.

Cold Blood right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit -- the Assassination burst button, since the spec has no Adrenaline Rush. Does not spend combo points, so it is safe to check ahead of the finishers below regardless of which one ends up spending them.

Venom as an alternate finisher if the Assassination tree grants it: spend 5 combo points here instead of on Eviscerate below, for the poison damage and proc-chance buff. Without the talent, this falls through to Eviscerate.
Eviscerate at five combo points: the finisher used when Venom isn't talented, checked ahead of Slice and Dice's refresh so a full five-point finisher is never given up in favor of a refresh.

Slice and Dice: only ever spend combo points on it once there are five banked, and only when it actually needs it -- down entirely, or under 3s remaining. Kept at the same five-combo-point floor as Eviscerate above so combo points are never spent below five on either finisher; Eviscerate above claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant.

Mutilate as the Forever Assassination talent's intended combo-point builder: a talented rogue strikes with both weapons here for 2 combo points. Without the talent, this falls through to Sinister Strike.

Sinister Strike as the combo point builder for a rogue without the Mutilate talent. Gated on Mutilate being unknown: once the talent is taken, an unguarded Sinister Strike (cheaper still with Improved Sinister Strike) out-competes Mutilate for the energy pool and Mutilate fires once per fight (the ladder's level-50 rung lost 3.4 dps to exactly that).
